02 · ABOUT ME

Digital marketer, on the client-facing side

My digital marketing journey started with an internship at Dotcom Creativez, Kochi, where I trained and worked on real-time SEO, social media and performance marketing projects. Running live campaigns from day one gave me the practical foundation I still use today.

That experience led to my current role as a Digital Marketing Executive at Enovexa Solutions. In over a year I've grown from learning the channels to managing client accounts end to end — keyword research, content planning, ad setup, analytics reporting and reviewing results with clients.

My goal is simple: help businesses turn marketing spend into measurable results.

Results summary — Meta Ads messaging campaigns

  • Ran 6 Facebook & Instagram ads across 4 campaigns, optimised for WhatsApp/Messenger conversations.
  • Generated 459 conversations at an average of ₹12.85 each from ₹5,900 spend, reaching 90,786 people.
  • Top campaign: Pavizham Lakshadweep — 163 conversations at ₹13.83 each, reaching 48,461 people.
  • Tested language creatives for Easy Car Spray: the Malayalam ad drove 148 of the campaign's 163 conversations at just ₹3.73 each, versus 1 from the English ad.
  • Average frequency of 1.35 means ads were not over-served to the same people, keeping reach efficient.
